verifiedObservedFacts.fact: After the first-run language and tutorial prompts were cleared, the captured run reached the actual turn-based world map with the Celts game state visible.
verifiedObservedFacts.boundary: This is direct black-box game-entry evidence for the captured validation window only.

verifiedObservedFacts.fact: A bounded horizontal swipe visibly changed the map viewport, and a later map tap produced visible movement-target feedback on the playable map.
verifiedObservedFacts.boundary: Only the captured input-to-visible-state response is promoted; AI, economy, combat resolution, hidden scoring and long-run strategy rules are not inferred.

verifiedObservedFacts.fact: The Unciv package remained alive and foreground after the observed map interactions with no captured FATAL EXCEPTION, native SIGABRT/SIGSEGV or ANR marker.
verifiedObservedFacts.boundary: This proves the captured validation window and does not claim indefinite long-run stability.

distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.lesson: A healthy strategy game runtime can still be blocked from meaningful play evidence by sequential first-run prompts even after the main map has loaded behind them.
distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: For Roblox mobile onboarding, distinguish app readiness, modal onboarding completion and the first unobstructed playable state instead of treating them as one milestone.

distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.lesson: A bounded swipe on the playable strategy map produced an immediately visible viewport change while preserving the surrounding game UI context.
distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: When validating Roblox touch camera or map navigation, capture before/after viewport evidence and keep core HUD context stable enough for the player to understand the movement.

distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.lesson: A tap on the playable map produced visible contextual movement-target feedback rather than relying on an invisible state change.
distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: For Roblox mobile interactions, make actionable touch results visibly legible near the interaction context and verify that feedback from captured runtime evidence.

distilledFailurePatterns.lesson: Repeated map taps did not prove gameplay while tutorial prompts were still intercepting input; the application itself remained healthy.
distilledFailurePatterns.reuseRule: Classify stale onboarding-modal coordinates as an automation-stage failure, correct the observed control boundary, and rerun without weakening the gameplay evidence gate.

allowed: portable mobile interaction lessons that may inform later Roblox-specific implementation and verification
stillForbidden: treating Android evidence as Roblox runtime evidence
inferring hidden AI, economy, combat or scoring rules
copying game artwork, UI trade dress, names or implementation details into a Roblox game
claims about long-run strategy balance or progression not measured by the captured validation window
